trajectory_summary: The call opens with a self-disqualifying worry, gets calmly reassured, survives a long and clunky bill-collection detour complicated by the customer's age, hearing, and landline, and closes with a next-day appointment. Energy is mixed rather than clean: rapport built during the small talk and the roof reassurance, but the close is procedurally thin — no co-owner confirmation, no one-hour block, no computer/no-driving instruction, no verbal handshake.
outcome_dispute: v1 tag should be read as booked-but-fragile, not a clean booked. A day and time were captured (22:07-22:23) but the button_up beat was almost entirely skipped — no hour-block, no no-driving/computer instruction, no 'is that fair' handshake, and no on-call promise of a confirmation text. The wife (Anne), confirmed as co-owner at 03:02, was never addressed for the appointment. Given the setter is paid on sits that survive to full proposal, this appointment carries real no-show/fragility risk.
